# AllSportsAPI

> OpenAPI 3.0 specs and copy-paste Python/JavaScript examples for Recodex sports data APIs: live scores, fixtures, standings, odds, lineups, players, and shotmaps.

Auth is RapidAPI headers `X-RapidAPI-Key` and `X-RapidAPI-Host`. Keep the key on a server. Football live path is `/api/matches/live` on `footapi7.p.rapidapi.com`; other sports prefix the sport, e.g. `/api/tennis/...`. Status codes: `200` data, `204` empty, `429` rate limit, `5xx` retry.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/lacassef/recodex-api-examples/blob/master/README.md): hub, sport hosts, quick start
- [AllSportsAPI guide](https://github.com/lacassef/recodex-api-examples/blob/master/allsportsapi/README.md): auth, data model, workflows
- [FAQ](https://github.com/lacassef/recodex-api-examples/blob/master/allsportsapi/FAQ.md): leagues, match clock, images, errors
- [Examples](https://github.com/lacassef/recodex-api-examples/blob/master/allsportsapi/Examples/README.md): Python and Node clients
